observations.value: Decision (accepted Oct 18, 2026): (1) Project can_view is part of the minimal set in every mode. On LXD 5.21.8 and 6.9, LXD refuses to add project can_view_instances, instance can_view or instance can_access_files to a group that cannot view the project ("Entitlement ... references project \"default\", but the project cannot be viewed by the group"); the attestor's least-privilege table gains project can_view on each allowed project in every mode. (2) Project can_view alone (identity l16-project) reads GET /1.0/projects/{name} with its config, features.networks included, standalone and through every member of three-member clusters of both versions, and sees no instance (404 on the instance read and the files API, the uuid filter finds none). The network selector therefore needs no option: selectors.network_project is removed, and the selector is always network:<project>/<network>, with the project that holds the network (the instance's project when it has features.networks=true, default otherwise); the server reads the project only when the network selector is enabled and the instance has a managed NIC. A missing project and one hidden from the identity both answer 404, an untrusted client 403; the project fixtures are the contract of the project read. Evidence: runs 20261018T084149Z-g-l16-*, 20261018T084500Z-g-l16-c5; fixtures test/fixtures/{5.21.8,6.9}/projects/.
